summary: Saved dashboard annotations excluded from long-range sampling causing linked alerts to not trigger
description:
Issue summary: 
Customer reports that annotations placed on saved dashboards are intermittently absent when viewing long time ranges (>= 30 days). When annotations are missing, alerts that rely on annotation-linked tracehooks do not fire even though the underlying metric breach occurs.

Impact:
- SparrowHealth (dedicated) has missed three scheduled escalation alerts tied to an incident annotation; this delayed their on-call response for ~90 minutes.
- Affects any saved dashboard with annotations older than the retention sampling threshold; severity P1 due to missed alerts.

Environment:
- prod: us-east (customer dedicated cluster)
- Console v3.4.1 + retention-service v1.7.0 deployed 2026-03-09

Steps to reproduce:
1) Open a saved dashboard with annotations older than 30 days.
2) Set time range to 90d and enable sampling in the query UI.
3) Inspect annotation list and check any alerts that reference the annotation's tracehook.
4) Trigger metric breach that should have alerted in the annotation window.

Observed behavior:
- Annotations older than the retention-service sampling boundary are omitted from the dashboard rendering and the annotation->tracehook join is not performed during the alert evaluation.
- Alert evaluation logs show no tracehook lookup calls for the omitted annotations.

Expected behavior:
- Annotations should be surfaced in dashboard UI even when sampling is applied, and tracehook links used by alerts must be evaluated for the full time range of the alert's window.

Temporary workaround:
- Edit the dashboard time range to a shorter window (<30d) or re-save the annotation with a recent timestamp. Neither is acceptable as a long term fix for customers with long retention windows.

Attachments:
- Customer-provided trace of the alert evaluation (attached as trace_eval_sparrow_2026-03-09.json in ticket).
- Screenshot of dashboard with missing annotations (dashboard_missing_annotations.png).
comments: 2026-03-10 Sophie Martinez: Received from customer at 09:22 UTC. They reported missed pager alerts tied to incident annotation on /ops-health dashboard. Collected screenshots and evaluation trace. Escalating to platform engineering because this causes missed alerts.

2026-03-10 Arjun Patel (Assigned): Acknowledged and starting triage. Initial suspicion: retention-service sampling policy changed in 1.7.0; will reproduce in staging with long-range queries. Asked SRE for a prod snapshot of retention config.

2026-03-11 Elena Kim (SRE): Prod retention config attached. Sampling cutoff set to 30 days for warm storage; compaction job run at 2026-03-09 02:00 UTC. No errors in compaction logs but I see samples dropped in the annotation index during compaction window.

2026-03-12 Arjun Patel (Eng): Reproduced in staging with retention-service v1.7.0. When query planner uses "sampled-aggregation" path, annotation join is replaced with a cheap tag-lookup that filters out low-cardinality annotation rows. Hypothesis: optimiser is incorrectly classifying annotation index as low-value for sampled paths.
2026-03-13 Sophie Martinez (Support): Updated customer with interim workaround (re-save annotations). Customer requests ETA for a permanent fix and asks for postmortem once resolved.

2026-03-13 Arjun Patel (Eng): Patch PR opened to force full annotation join during alert eval when time range > sampling cutoff. Need review and canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/7892
investigation_notes: Reproduction in staging: toggling the query planner to 'sampled-aggregation' causes the annotation join stage to be rewritten into an index-only filter that skips low-population annotation rows. Annotation storage uses a separate index with TTL markers; compaction sets a 'sampled' flag on older rows. The alert evaluator currently skips any annotation rows marked 'sampled' when the alert window triggers a 'fast-path' evaluation. Logs: alert_eval: no_tracehook_lookup recorded. Correlated compaction run during customer's incident. Root cause hypothesis: optimizer + retention-sampling tag interaction removes annotations from join when fast-path sampling is selected.
resolution_notes:
Short term: Feature flag 'force_full_annotation_join' enabled for SparrowHealth cluster at 2026-03-13 18:40 UTC. This restored alerts for their dashboards. Medium term: PR 7892 implements a guard in the planner to preserve annotation joins for alert evaluation regardless of sampling path. PR requires canary and integration test for long-range evals. Long term: update retention-service docs and add an alert when annotation index sample rate > 0.5.

Follow-ups assigned:
- ENG-ops: Add integration test for alert + annotation behavior (owner: Arjun).
- SRE: Add monitoring for 'annotation_sampled_ratio' per org (owner: Elena).
- DOCS: Update annotation retention caveat (owner: Maya).
next_steps: Merge PR 7892 after review and run canary on dedicated clusters (scheduled 2026-03-14).
Roll out retention-service hotfix if planner change insufficient (backup plan).
Publish postmortem to customer and internal incident channel once full rollout completed.
